title: Nightglass Courier
premise: A courier seeking admission to the upper routes abandons his qualifying delivery when a glass ray attacks a suspended maintenance lift. His tiny one-line pulling skill saves a stranded worker and earns a dangerous address.
emotional_engine: Aren wants his skill acknowledged by the city above; under pressure he chooses the work worth being known for, then resents the price rather than smiling away his ambition.
future_engine: Deliveries into erased districts, rival couriers and glass fauna expose who controls the city routes. Progression comes from stronger anchors, load judgment and increasingly bold blade-assisted maneuvers.

style_contract.medium: Thin controlled anime contours, elegant facial planes, angular dark hair, tailored pale jacket against black clothing; luminous glass translucency against layered inhabited navy architecture.
style_contract.retain: The integrated invitation of face, creature, city and night atmosphere; inhabited balconies and quiet cyan windows.
style_contract.avoid: Bodybuilder armor, uniform low-angle full-body shots, wet reflective pavement, citywide speckle and a ray inserted behind every close-up.

cast.name: Aren Vale
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult man, slim athletic build, narrow appealing face, gray eyes, swept midnight hair. Tailored ivory waist-length jacket WITH long sleeves over fitted black high-neck top, black slim trousers, plain boots and one red courier cord. Closer to original full Nightglass elegance; distinct provisional adaptation, not automatic original cast selection.
cast.equipment: One solid silver crescent-edge short sword, black straight hilt, cyan pommel ring; RIGHT hand always. Flat sealed cream dispatch wallet on belt.

cast.name: Sera Voss
cast.visual: Light-skinned square-faced woman, copper chin-length bob, burgundy tailored thighcoat, black trousers and boots. City route inspector, dry wit rather than antagonist.
cast.equipment: Simple black short spear carried upright when present; no use in this pilot.

cast.name: Pell
cast.visual: Light-skinned older man with short gray hair, stubble, mustard maintenance jacket and charcoal trousers, broad work harness.
cast.equipment: Harness attached to lift rail until transfer.

cast.name: Glass ray
cast.visual: Single immense navy translucent glass-wing ray, broad crescent wings, cyan circular sensory lights, narrow central beak, one long tail. Living alien animal; no humanoid face.

setting: Layered vertical city at blue night. Upper admission gate on RIGHT, maintenance lift below LEFT side of same bridge, thick black metal anchor posts. Warm human windows, distant hanging gardens.
power_rule: Tension Line: one thin cyan line from the RIGHT sword pommel to ONE visible metal anchor pulls Aren toward that anchor. It cannot push or lift the whole maintenance car. Carrying another adult visibly strains his grounded shoulder/stance.

editorial_rules: All story and cast choices are provisional independent pilot options, not owner-selected canon.
Every panel is a new composition. Original anchors guide drawing and appeal, never a collage or reused final panel.
Adult principal cast only. No generated lettering: exact dialogue is editable gallery typography.
Quiet matte floors and grouped surfaces. Preserve medium-defining contour/brush/hatch marks.
One frozen instant per panel. Current-state field is authoritative; never import later damage into an earlier panel.
reading_length_note: Compact 16-panel pilot. Designed for roughly 3–5 minutes including art contemplation; actual reading speed varies. Not a claim of full serialized chapter length.
